subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Arbon, the staff member

745030101.text: Welcome, dear guests, we meet again. It has not been long, and yet I miss you a little already.

745030103.text: Ah, woe is me, loathed am I! How the pain stings. Perhaps I'd best get back to work.

745030104.text: Let me state first that the planned data collection project will be divided into two parts. One will be run by Alberre, and the other by me.

745030105.text: On my side, we wish to model the agility of a Champion Duelist, and so we'll need you to complete a few underwater speed challenges.

745030106.text: Huh, do Champion Duelists have to train underwater?

745030107.text: Who knows? I do not know one personally, and I don't think the boss knows any either. He probably just thinks that it's cooler this way.

745030108.text: He originally wanted to install 10 different water-drawing mechanisms that can spray jets of water, but eventually gave up on this idea due to the high cost.

745030111.text: Well, Fontaine is the realm of water, after all, and if this is to be sold in other nations, a little Fontainian flair is needed.

745030112.text: Anyway, we've prepared a handbook with relevant details. Please peruse it at your disposal.

745030113.text: Well, are you two raring to go already?

745030115.text: No problem. The data collection devices have already been placed over there, so you need not worry about them. You just need to focus on completing the challenge.
